2005.desc: Ashwa Racing's first prototype, RZ05 Combustion, was the first student-built Formula Student vehicle in Asia to compete at Formula SAE Australasia. The event record lists Best Cost and Best Asian Team, while the founding account also reports a Best Endeavour Award. RZ05 established the foundation of Ashwa Racing's combustion programme.
